flows:
Navigate to https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
Look at the controls in the homepage header.
The search icon is before the topic links.
Tab until the search icon is visibly focused.
Use Tab and Enter to open the site search.
Verify the Search text box is visible.
